name: ragas-evaluation-system
description: RAGAS Evaluation System - Frontend + Backend + Python

scripts.setup:workspaces: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev: npx concurrently --names "frontend,backend,python" --prefix-colors "cyan,green,yellow" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:python"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
